def find_path(graph, start, goal):
    path = []
    visited = set()
    stack = [[start]]
    while stack:
        node_path = stack.pop()
        node = node_path[-1]
        if node in visited:
            continue
        visited.add(node)
        if node == goal:
            return node_path
        for neighbor in graph.get(node, []):
            new_path = list(node_path)
            new_path.append(neighbor)
            stack.append(new_path)
    return None
